name: ntr_db_get_paticipant_territory_mapping
xsql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    pa_input.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
    pa_active.territory AS territory
FROM xactly.xc_period per 
INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_input 
    ON pa_input.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_active 
    ON pa_input.employee_id = pa_active.employee_id
    AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pa_active.effective_start_date AS DATE)
    AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pa_active.effective_end_date AS DATE)
WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
